title: App Exception Family
prompt: Define AppError(Exception), ValidationError(AppError), and NotFoundError(AppError). Then implement get_item(items: dict, key) that raises NotFoundError (message must contain the key) for missing keys and returns the value otherwise.

tests.name: missing raises NotFoundError
tests.hint: Raise NotFoundError with the key in the message.

tests.name: hierarchy is real
tests.hint: NotFoundError must be catchable as AppError.
